summary: Revision 2: fixed seek scrub (local scrubRatio + commitScrubRatio) and AC-18 MediaRecorder.pause/resume on visibility (fail-closed if unsupported). Also fixed warnings: skip live key capture while replaying, announce Export started only on status kind transition, clamp seek to [0,N−1], delay blob URL revoke. 34 unit tests green; typecheck clean.
goal: Climb replay should allow fast forwarding, rewind, pause/play. Export as mp4.

feedbackAddressed.message: Seek scrub broken while playing — controlled range with no local scrub state
feedbackAddressed.resolution: ReplayTransportBar keeps scrubRatio state while pointer down; value binds to local; pointerup commits via commitScrubRatio then clears

feedbackAddressed.message: Visibility pause does not pause MediaRecorder/captureStream — duration pads with frozen frames
feedbackAddressed.resolution: exportVisibility.pauseExportRecorder on enter paused_hidden; resumeExportRecorder on visible; missing pause/resume → AC-19 error
useClimb keydown skips when replayInputs active; shouldCaptureGameKey(replaying=true)===false
Removed onClick speak; announce only on exportStatus.kind transition to running
ReplaySnapshotCache.seek clamps with Math.max(0, n-1); unit asserts seek(n)===seek(n-1)

feedbackAddressed.message: Delay blob URL revoke after download click

learnings.insight: AC-18 requires MediaRecorder.pause/resume in addition to pausing the encode step loop; browsers without pause/resume must fail closed (AC-19) rather than pad duration with frozen captureStream frames.
learnings.action: Assert pauseExportRecorder on hidden≥3s and resumeExportRecorder on visible with a fake recorder; reject tests that only check status.kind===paused_hidden.

learnings.insight: Revision 2: 34 production-invoking unit tests pass (transport 12, snapshots 6, mime 5, useClimb 5, exportVisibility 6); typecheck clean. Critical scrub + MediaRecorder visibility covered without source greps.
learnings.action: Re-verify AC-7 scrub commit via commitScrubRatio and AC-18 via exportVisibility helpers before qa-acceptance.

learnings.insight: aria-live export announcements must key off status.kind transitions, not every running percent update or optimistic onClick — otherwise users hear false starts before MIME/captureStream errors (AC-17).
learnings.action: Announce Export started only when kind transitions to running; never speak from the Export button click path.

notes.securityReviewer: security-reviewer-2026-09-06T160305Z.json passed (0 critical); no security regressions expected from pause/resume + delayed revoke
